messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: autoscale-failure - GPU pool us-south2 failing node provisioning due to quota errors. Incident created: INC-2026-3147. Severity P1. Pager: Maya Chen.

Maya Chen: I'm on it. Seeing spike in pending pods for inference-deploy, provisioning attempts failing with 403 Quota errors. Starting triage.

Jonah Patel: Can you paste the exact error from node-provisioner logs? I'll prep a cloud support case template.

Maya Chen: Logs: 
```
2026-03-15T18:11:02Z node-provisioner ERROR: unable to create instance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_A100_GPUS' exceeded for project my-prod-project  (or resource)
```
Also autoscaler desired=18, ready=3, pending=1200. Queue backlog for route `gen-api-v2` ~3.2k.

Leah Ortiz: Alert: error-rate 5.8% for hosted routes, 95p latency 11s. Several high-traffic customers experiencing 503s. Claire, do we have active escalations?

Claire CS: Support: two customers reported increased latencies 5m ago. ACME and BetaApps. I'll prepare outbound once we confirm root cause and mitigation.

Maya Chen: Short mitigations I'm going to try in parallel:
- Toggle routing rule to spill non-SLA traffic to us-central1 (capacity there).
- Reduce batch workers and throttle low-priority batch queues.
- Enable autoscaler to accept mixed GPU types (A100 -> T4 fallback) in-region.
- Contact GCP for emergency quota increase + request temporary quota reallocation from dev projects.

DeployBot: Change set queued: route/spill-us-south2 -> us-central1 (non-sla). Owner: Maya Chen.

Maya Chen: Applied routing rule. Starting with 25% spill. Monitoring.

Leah Ortiz: Spill observed: 24% traffic to us-central1. us-south2 queue down to 2.2k. Latency 95p down to 8s. Error-rate down to 3.9%.

Jonah Patel: Filing case with GCP now. Case: CASE-4492. Description: urgent quota exhaustion for A100 GPUs in region us-south2 affecting production autoscaling. Attaching metrics and provisioning logs. Request: temporary +30 A100 quota or reassign from staging projects.

Nina (infra-ops): We have a small amount of unused GPU quota in dev and ci projects. I can do manual transfer if approvals in place. Need owner confirmation for reallocation window.

Maya Chen: Please proceed if you can reallocate immediately, Nina. Otherwise I'll continue with fallbacks.

Nina (infra-ops): Reallocation initiated: moved 12 A100 quota from dev-project-2 -> my-prod-project. Propagation may take 5-10 mins.

Maya Chen: Enabling autoscaler fallback config to allow provisioning T4 nodes in us-south2. Note: model compatibility required, Omar confirm T4 variant readiness.

Omar Ruiz: T4 variants built and tested for most workloads. Exceptions: large-context models >8k may degrade. I'll set a compatibility matrix and ensure inference-router maps model families accordingly. Enabling now.

Maya Chen: Command used: 
```
# allow fallback GPUs
redwoodctl config set autoscaler.us-south2.fallback_gpus="T4,K80" --apply
```

DeployBot: Config change applied. Autoscaler attempting to provision T4 nodes. Some node creation logs: 
```
2026-03-15T18:16:03Z googleapi: Instance created: projects/my-prod-project/zones/us-south2a/instances/ri-worker-345
```

Leah Ortiz: Mixed progress. Queue now 1.1k, 95p latency 4.6s, error-rate 1.8%. But still many pending pods waiting for A100-backed nodes for large requests.

Jonah Patel: GCP responded to CASE-4492: initial reply acknowledging, asking for justification and traffic graphs. They can provision quota increase but timeline ~2-5 hours. Also suggested using different machine families as workaround.

Maya Chen: Meanwhile, I'm enabling priority admission control: throttle batch queue and deprioritize non-SLA clients. Applying admission policy: 
```
admissionctl set-policy inference batch_priority=low limit=50%
```

Leah Ortiz: Batch traffic reduced ~60%, freeing GPUs for latency-critical requests. Queue dropped to 600 within 10m.

Claire CS: Draft customer note ready for hosted-impacted list. Will include: acknowledgement, short mitigation summary (routing + throttles), and ETA estimate. Holding for final sign-off.

Nina (infra-ops): The manual quota reallocation became effective. GCP console shows +12 A100 available. Autoscaler is now provisioning more A100 nodes.

Maya Chen: Good. Autoscaler desired now trending down to 10 as it stabilizes. Current ready nodes 9, pending 0. Queue ~180. Taking note of cold-cache misses affecting latencies but acceptable.

Jonah Patel: GCP follow-up: they can provision a temporary increase of +20 A100 within 1-3 hours if we submit a formal request. Suggest we request +20 and then decommission dev-project reassignments afterwards.

Omar Ruiz: Running quick quality checks on T4-provisioned workers: microbenchmarks show ~6-8% slower token throughput for large-context models, but output quality unchanged. I'll add a note to routing rules to route long-context sessions only to A100 when possible.

Maya Chen: Action items and owners:
- Jonah: escalate to account manager for temporary +20 quota and confirm timeline (in progress).
- Nina: revert dev-project reallocation once quota increase is in place (pending).
- Omar: finalize model routing rules to avoid routing >8k contexts to T4 nodes (in progress).
- Leah: keep monitoring SLOs and post updates every 10m until stable (in progress).
- Claire: send customer comms after Maya sign-off (pending).

Maya Chen: Noting a residual problem: autoscaler didn't surface quota errors as a specific failure mode. Recommend adding an autoscaler probe that detects cloud API 403 for quotas and triggers automated routing/fallback. Jonah, please add to follow-ups.

Jonah Patel: Affirmative. Filing infra issue: INFRA-1138 - autoscaler quota-failure detection & auto-routing.

Leah Ortiz: SLO snapshot: error-rate back down to 0.4%, 95p latency ~2.6s, queue ~120. No new customer complaints in past 15m.

IncidentBot: Status update: INC-2026-3147 -> mitigated (partial). Keep open for postmortem.

Maya Chen: I'll keep the incident live until we have permanent quota assurances and autoscaler detection in place. Thanks for moving quickly. Quick note for the postmortem: timeline of events, manual quota reallocation, routing spill, T4 fallback impact, and recommended fixes (reserve quotas per region, automation to reassign quota, autoscaler detection, runbook for cross-project reallocation).

Claire CS: Sending customer notice now to impacted hosts. Included offer for pro-rated credits if SLA breached. Posting copy to #customer-notifications.

Maya Chen: Standown: continue monitoring for 30m, if stable then close. Good job team. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Change summary: route spill applied -> us-central1 (non-SLA), autoscaler fallback enabled, batch throttle set.

Omar Ruiz: I'll document the commands used and add to runbook under "regional-quota-exhaustion".

Maya Chen: Closing incident thread for now. Will reopen if we see regressions.
